text:
alex: heads-up — deploybot auto-pinned runtime 6.2 for model=convo-lite in prod-canary after increased error-rate on long-prompt flows :thinking:

deploybot: auto-pin triggered by 5xxs >0.7% over 10m on canary-convo-lite. Pin applied: runtime=6.2 -> 6.1. Reason: KV-cache eviction interaction with quantized attention kernels.

maria: quick telemetry: failures concentrated on seq_len>6144, small-batch concurrent requests. p95 latency unaffected, but error spike consistent.

kevin: options: rollback to 6.1 on canary (fast), push a small runtime shim to tolerate eviction ordering (2-3h), or repackage the model quant artifacts (1.5h). What's acceptable for prod?

alex: rollback on canary seems safest to restore reliability. We can hold the pin and validate a mitigation before any unpin.

maria: agree. I'll run longseq smoke for 8h after rollback. If clean, we coordinate staggered unpin in the next change window.

alex: @deploybot please apply rollback to runtime=6.1 for canary-us-east with TTL=6h. Annotate: "kv-evict-convo-lite". Do not touch dedicated pools.

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued: /deploy rollback runtime=6.2 -> runtime=6.1 --target canary-us-east --ttl 6h --annot "kv-evict-convo-lite"

deploybot: rollback started at 2976543300. Rolling back shard-2.

ops-bot: reminder: rolling node restarts may cause transient 5xxs. Run warmup traffic after rollback completes.

maria: warmup script queued, will run perf diff post-rollback. Test command: curl -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"convo-lite","seq_len":8192,"prompt":"warmup"}'

deploybot: rollback complete at 2976543460. All targeted canary shards on runtime=6.1. TTL set to 2976547060.

alex: thanks. Maria please post telemetry and recommended next steps (shim vs repackage). I'll update release notes: "Temporary rollback on canary for convo-lite due to KV-cache/quant interaction; mitigation in progress."

maria: will post results. Early signal: repackaging quant artifacts looks lower risk and faster overall. Plan: repack on staging, run embedding/token-consistency tests, then request unpin for change window with staged rollforward.

kevin: filing ticket for runtime compatibility matrix update to include KV-eviction semantics so auto-pin rules can be more targeted.

alex: closing immediate ops — keep thread updated if TTL expires or deploybot triggers further actions. :white_check_mark:
